in countries all over the world
in millions of children have found no link

but it doesn't stop there.

by health authorities, and maybe that's a little bit true, because the studies they're
showing here are worth less than a fart in the summer breeze.

to analyze data for more than one million Danish children born between 1997 and 2018.
That study examined 50 different conditions and found no link between vaccines in risk
of developing autism, autoimmune diseases, asthma, or allergic conditions.

Denmark found no link between the MMR vaccine and autism.

differ from the schedule in the United States.

at 4 years.

it kind of takes some time to see just why these claims are so wrong.

maybe that's true, maybe we should wait, we just want to do what's best for our child.
